items.title: 25.1.2 Retrosynthesis (target se ulta peeche ki taraf sochna) (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Retrosynthesis bilkul synthesis ka ulat hai. Is mein target molecule ko less complicated (kam mushkil), simple aur aasani se milne wale compounds mein toora jata hai jo starting material ban sakein. Retrosynthesis disconnection approach (bond ko kaghaz par torne ka tareeqa) istemal karti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf Target Molecule aur daen taraf Starting Material, beech mein do open retrosynthetic arrows starting material ki taraf. Oopar magenta loop 'Retrosynthesis' target molecule se starting material tak jata hai; neeche cyan loop 'Synthesis' starting material se wapas target molecule tak aata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.1: Synthesis aur retrosynthesis ke routes (raaste) (kitab ki Figure 25.1 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar wala arrow (loop) retrosynthesis hai: target molecule se peeche ki taraf starting material tak. Neeche wala arrow (loop) synthesis hai: starting material se aage target molecule tak. Beech ke open arrows (⇒) retrosynthetic arrows hain.

Retrosynthesis mein target molecule ke woh bonds tore jate hain jin se structure kaafi had tak simple ho jaye. Aise kai disconnections ke baad hum aakhir kaar simple aur aasani se milne wale starting materials tak pohanch jate hain.
